newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX crude falls on fund rolling ahead of expiry.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX crude falls on fund rolling ahead of expiry.

text.p: NYMEX crude fell Monday afternoon in the spot month against the back months as funds rolled positions from the February contract into March ahead of the contract's expiry Tuesday.
"Rolling is probably the only feature today. Volume is fairly light, and you are really not seeing as much short covering today," said Rocky D'Esposito of RJ Futures.

At 1410 EST, February crude was off 16 cents at $25.25 cents a barrel while March was up eight cents at $24.51. The Feb/March spread has fallen after rising more than $1.00 earlier amid remnant short covering in Feb from Friday.
On Friday, supply disruptions in crude prompted concerns of inventory tightness, sparking short covering in the spot month and the resulting growth in the Feb/March spread.
Feb heating oil fell 1.14 cents to 67.30 cents a gallon, under pressure by selling in the heating oil-to-crude crack spread, dealers said.
The Feb heat-to-crude crack fell to $3.04 a barrel from $3.33 Friday.
Feb gasoline continued weak along with heating oil, off 0.44 cent at 67.65 cents a gallon.
((-- Harry Milling, New York Energy Desk, 212-859-1761))
